name: cam09-development-audit-v1

selection.method: Fixed timestamps selected before reviewing model output. Every YOLO track visible at each timestamp was included.
selection.evidence_view: Full CCTV frame with highlighted target plus an enlarged target-person crop.

label_contract.using_phone: A smartphone is visibly held or actively viewed.
label_contract.working: The target is actively using a laptop, paper, pen, document, tool, or machine.
label_contract.talking_or_interacting: The target is visibly interacting with another person without active work.
label_contract.no_observable_task: No clear phone use, work task, or interaction is visible.

audit_basis: Visual review of every selected target panel.
Earlier reviewer corrections were retained: track 5 phone use, track 6 no task, track 13 not working, track 16 working when using the laptop, and the standing red-shirt track not working.
Multiple allowed labels are used only where a single still cannot reliably separate working from conversation.
